content.text: bisphos inhibit osteoclasts; USU the drugs of choice for cancer-associated hypercalcemia; zoledronic acid 4 mg IV once lowers Ca for an avg of > 40 days; pamidronate 60 to 90 mg IV once, repeated only after 7 days; lowers Ca for ≤ 2 wks; repeated IV bisphos (bone mets, myeloma) are linked to ONJ; renal toxicity reported w zoledronic acid; PO bisphos can maintain norm Ca but aren't generally used acutely; denosumab: cancer-associated hypercalcemia ⍉responding to bisphos; 120 mg SC Q4wks + extra doses on days 8 and 15 of the first mo; give Ca and vitD prn to avert hypocalcemia; calcitonin (salmon) 4 to 8 IU/kg SC every 12 h; can ↓Ca by 1 to 2 mg/dL w.in a few hrs; in cancer-associated hypercalcemia, limited by short action w tachyphylaxis (often after ~48 h) and ⍉response in ≥ 40%. salmon calcitonin + prednisone may control Ca for mo in some CA pts.

CI: hypocalcemia (must be corrected b4 starting Xgeva). CI: known clinically sig hypersensitivity to Xgeva or denosumab prod. Can cause severe Sxtomatic hypocalcemia w/ fatal cases; correct hypocalcemia b4 starting; monitor Ca esp in the first wks; adequately supp all pts w/ Ca and vitD. ↑ risk of hypocalcemia w/ increasing renal dysfun, most commonly severe dysfun (CrCl < 30 mL/min and/or on dialysis), and w/ inadeq/⍉Ca supp. Hypersensitivity rxns incl anaphylaxis may occur; d/c permanently if a clinically sig rxn occurs. ONJ reported; perform an oral exam b4 starting; monitor for Sx; ⍉ invasive dental procedures during tx. Atypical femoral frx: evaluate pts w/ thigh or groin pain to r/o a femoral frx. Multi vertebral frx reported after discontinuation; when Xgeva = stopped, evaluate the pt's risk for vertebral frx. Hypercalcemia requiring hsp and complicated by acute renal inj reported after tx discontinuation in pts w/ giant cell tumor of bone and growing skeletons. May cause fetal harm; advise females of reprod potential to use effective contraception during therapy and for at least 5 mo after the last dose. Pts receiving Xgeva should ⍉ receive other denosumab prod concomitantly.

CI: hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon or any of the excipients (rxns incl anaphylaxis w/ death, bronchospasm, and swelling of the tongue or throat). Serious hypersensitivity rxns incl fatal anaphylaxis reported; consider skin testing b4 tx in pts w/ sus hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon. Hypocalcemia w/ tetany (musc cramps, twitching) and sz activity reported; hypocalcemia must be corrected b4 initiating therapy. Meta-analysis of 21 trials suggests an ↑ risk of overall malig in calcitonin salmon-treated pts. Circulating antibodies to calcitonin salmon may develop and may cause loss of response to tx. Use for Paget's dz or postmenopausal osteoporosis = recommended w/ an adequate intake of Ca and vitD. Concomitant lithium may ↓ plasma lithium concentrations (↑ urinary clearance); lithium dose may require adj. OD: hypocalcemic tetany could occur; keep parenteral calcium available for tx. MC adverse rxns: nausea w/ or w/o vomiting (10%), inj site inflam (10%), and flushing of the face or hands (2% to 5%). ←the poss assoc b/n malig and calcitonin salmon use, the need for continued therapy should be re-evaluated periodically.
